seo.title: AI + Machine Vision | openIndu Industrial Machine Vision
seo.description: openIndu Machine Vision: AI-driven industrial vision inspection and recognition, covering defect detection, positioning/measurement, and quality control.

hero.title: AI + Machine Vision
hero.description: A deep-learning-based industrial vision inspection system for automated product-quality inspection. Combining computer vision and AI, it gives smart manufacturing its "intelligent eye."

defect.title: Defect Detection
defect.description: Deep-learning algorithms automatically identify surface defects, with accuracy above 99%.

measurement.title: Dimensional Measurement
measurement.description: Sub-pixel-precision measurement for micron-level dimensional inspection.

recognition.title: Object Recognition
recognition.description: Real-time workpiece recognition and localization, supporting multi-target detection in complex scenes.

surfaceDefect.title: Surface Defect Detection
surfaceDefect.description: Detects scratches, dents, stains, and other surface defects -- replacing manual inspection to improve efficiency and accuracy.

dimension.title: Precision Dimensional Measurement
dimension.description: Non-contact, high-precision dimensional measurement, monitoring in real time whether products meet spec.

ocr.title: Character Recognition (OCR)
ocr.description: Reads serial numbers, production dates, QR codes, and other markings on products to enable traceability.

assembly.title: Assembly Verification
assembly.description: Checks whether components are correctly assembled and flags missing or incorrect parts, ensuring assembly quality.

color.title: Color Sorting
color.description: Precisely identifies and classifies product color, ensuring appearance consistency.

robotGuide.title: Robot Vision Guidance
robotGuide.description: Gives robots visual-positioning capability, guiding precise pick-and-place of workpieces.

caseStudy.heading: Real-World Case: openindu-station
caseStudy.intro: A motion-vision-scan universal equipment platform incubating in the openIndu community. Its vision module already drives two real products — a dual-camera precision dispensing machine and a dual-platform laser cutting machine.
caseStudy.overviewAlt: openindu-station main dashboard showing live camera feed, axis status, and run logs
caseStudy.overviewCaption: Station Overview · Live Feed & Axis Status
caseStudy.visionAlt: openindu-station Vision workbench showing template-matching and feature-detection tools
caseStudy.visionCaption: Vision Workbench · Template Matching & Hand-Eye Calibration

calibration.title: Nine-Point Hand-Eye Calibration
calibration.description: Pixel-to-machine-coordinate affine mapping; supports both eye-to-hand and eye-in-hand mounting

matching.title: Template Matching + Blob Dual Engine
matching.description: Contour, circle, line, and corner detection with sub-pixel precision

dualCamera.title: Dual-Camera Coordinated Positioning
dualCamera.description: Pre-alignment + fine-alignment two-tier precision guiding precision machining

caseStudy.status: Currently incubating in the openIndu community; not yet open-sourced.

capture.title: Image Capture
capture.description: Industrial cameras, lighting systems, and lens components form a high-quality image-capture system

preprocess.title: Image Preprocessing
preprocess.description: Denoising, enhancement, and correction algorithms improve image quality

aiAlgorithm.title: AI Detection Algorithms
aiAlgorithm.description: CNN, YOLO, Transformer, and other deep-learning models power intelligent detection

output.title: Result Output
output.description: Visualized detection results, statistical analysis, and integration with MES/ERP systems

accuracy.title: High Accuracy
accuracy.description: Deep-learning models trained on large datasets achieve over 99% detection accuracy, far exceeding manual inspection

speed.title: High-Speed Inspection
speed.description: Millisecond-level detection speed meets high-speed production-line demands without affecting takt time

learning.title: Continuous Learning
learning.description: Supports online learning and model updates, continuously improving detection performance as data accumulates

deployment.title: Easy Deployment
deployment.description: Modular design with edge-computing support enables rapid deployment on the production floor

cta.heading: Coming soon
cta.description: The AI + Machine Vision solution is in active development -- stay tuned.
